'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Siege of Gaza City]]
****[[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Israeli Defense Minister]] [[Yoav Gallant]] says that [[Israeli Ground Forces|Israeli troops]] have entered [[Gaza City]] from multiple directions with heavy clashes occurring "deep inside" the city. Gallant also claims that [[Hamas]] leader [[Yahya Sinwar]] is trapped in a [[bunker]] in the city centre. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-says-it-is-open-gaza-fighting-pauses-aid-hostages-2023-11-07/ (Reuters)]
**[[Gaza Strip evacuations]]
***[[United Nations]] monitors say that only about 5,000 [[Palestinian]]s have been evacuated from northern to southern Gaza on Monday, stating that "entire families, including children, elderly people and persons with disabilities" could only make the journey on foot as roads have been heavily damaged. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/7/israel-hamas-war-live-one-month-of-conflict-10000-dead-in-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Interior Minister of the Gaza Strip|Gaza's Interior Ministry]] announces that all [[bakery|bakeries]] in Gaza City and the [[North Gaza Governorate|North Gaza]] governorate are inoperable due to systematic targeting and shortages of fuel and flour. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1787283/all-bakeries-in-northern-gaza-out-of-service-officials (Dawn)]
**At least eight people are killed and dozens more are injured in [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] [[missile]] attacks on the [[Nasser Medical Complex]] in Gaza City, which includes the Al-Nasser Children's Hospital. [https://www.aljazeera.com/gallery/2023/11/7/israel-continues-to-attack-hospitals-in-gaza-city-killing-at-least-eight (Al Jazeera)]
**At least two [[Palestinians]] are killed and several others are injured in separate Israeli [[airstrike]]s near the [[Kamal Adwan Hospital]] in [[Beit Hanoun]] and near the [[Al-Quds Hospital]] in the Tal al-Hawa district of Gaza City. [https://www.aljazeera.com/gallery/2023/11/7/israel-continues-to-attack-hospitals-in-gaza-city-killing-at-least-eight (Al Jazeera)]
**At least eight people are killed when an Israeli airstrike hits a house in southern [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/7/israel-hamas-war-live-one-month-of-conflict-10000-dead-in-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
**At least five people, including a woman, are injured by an Israeli raid in the [[West Bank]]'s [[Tulkarem]] district. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/7/israel-hamas-war-live-one-month-of-conflict-10000-dead-in-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
**Israel appoints former [[ambassador]] Alon Roth-Snir to coordinate efforts for the [[2023 Israel–Hamas war hostage crisis|release of hostages]] held by Hamas in Gaza. [https://m.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-772078 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[Chiapas conflict]]
**The [[Zapatista Army of National Liberation]] announces that they are dissolving the [[Rebel Zapatista Autonomous Municipalities|autonomous municipalities]] they established after the 1994 [[Zapatista uprising|uprising]]. [https://www.pbs.org/newshour/world/mexicos-zapatista-indigenous-rebel-movement-says-it-is-dissolving-its-autonomous-municipalities (PBS)]
*[[Mali War]]
**The [[Malian Armed Forces]] conducts [[airstrike]]s on "terrorist targets" in [[Kidal]], resulting in civilian casualties, amidst claims by local [[Tuareg people|Tuareg]] groups and witnesses. [https://www.voaafrica.com/a/7345774.html (AFP via VOA)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**[[Operation 1027]]
***The [[People's Defence Force (Myanmar)|People's Defence Force]] captures the town of [[Khampat]] in the [[Kabaw Valley]], becoming the latest town to fall under the control of the opposition [[National Unity Government of Myanmar|National Unity Government]]. [https://burma.irrawaddy.com/news/2023/11/07/376153.html (Irrawaddy)]
***[[State Administration Council|Myanmar's military junta]] [[Chairman of the State Administration Council|leader]] [[Min Aung Hlaing]] holds an emergency meeting with [[Tatmadaw|the military]] in [[Yangon]] in response to recent advances by [[Three Brotherhood Alliance|rebel forces]] in [[Shan State]], and the killing of a [[Myanmar Army]] [[colonel]]. [https://www.irrawaddy.com/news/war-against-the-junta/myanmar-military-chiefs-gather-for-emergency-meeting.html (Irrawaddy)]
***A [[drone warfare|drone strike]] kills four people and injures six others in [[Bago Region]], [[Myanmar]]. [[State media]] accuses the [[People's Defence Force (Myanmar)|PDF]] of carrying out the attack. [https://english.news.cn/20231108/4e87c7c68e524d62aa89182408c5848b/c.html (Xinhua)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2023 inflation surge]]
**[[Bangladesh]] increases the [[minimum wage]] for [[Textile industry in Bangladesh|garment workers]] by nearly 56% to {{BDT|12,500|link=yes}} ([[United States dollar|US$]]113) per month, a move [[trade union]]s find insufficient against their demand for a {{BDT|23,000}} ($208) threshold amid rising [[costs of living]] and [[inflation]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/bangladesh-increases-garment-workers-minimum-pay-by-56-report-4553921 (AFP via NDTV)]
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**The [[International Labour Organization]] reports that job losses in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] and the [[West Bank]] are costing Palestinians US$16 million per day, with 182,000 jobs lost in Gaza, equivalent to 61 percent of the territory's total employment. A further 208,000 jobs were lost in the West Bank, equivalent to 24 percent of the territory's total employment. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/7/more-than-60-percent-of-jobs-lost-in-gaza-due-to-war-un-agency-says (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[2023 heat waves]]
**The [[Copernicus Climate Change Service]] reports that October 2023 is the hottest October observed, having surpassed previous [[Global temperature record|temperature records]] with global temperatures averaging {{convert|1.43|C-change}} above preindustrial levels. [https://www.france24.com/en/environment/20231108-record-temperatures-in-october-guarantee-2023-will-be-warmest-year-in-history (AFP via France 24)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israel–Turkey relations]]
***The [[Ministry of Trade (Turkey)|Turkish trade ministry]] reports that trade between [[Turkey]] and [[Israel]] decreased by half since the start of the war, compared with the same period last year. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/7/israel-hamas-war-live-one-month-of-conflict-10000-dead-in-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Malaysia]] says that it will not recognise unilateral [[United States sanctions|sanctions]], responding to a proposed [[US]] law that would impose sanctions on supporters of [[Hamas]] and other Palestinian groups. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-11-07/malaysia-renews-backing-for-hamas-as-us-sanctions-threat-looms (Bloomberg)]
**Representatives for [[China]] and the [[United Arab Emirates]] deliver a joint statement following a [[UN Security Council]] meeting, calling for a [[humanitarian]] [[ceasefire]], and adding that [[Law of war|"wars have laws and they must be upheld"]] as "[[civilians]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] cannot even find safety in [[UN]] facilities, hospitals and [[refugee camps]]". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/11/7/israel-hamas-war-live-one-month-of-conflict-10000-dead-in-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Myanmar–Russia relations]]
**[[Myanmar]] and [[Russia]] hold their first ever joint [[military exercise|naval exercise]] in the [[Andaman Sea]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-myanmar-navy-andaman-sea-1d0f0c692a4583a0c449e6c8cc3b620b (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**[[Killing of Paul Kessler]], [[Violent incidents in reaction to the 2023 Israel–Hamas war]]
***Paul Kessler, a Jewish man participating in a pro-[[Israel]] protest dies after being struck in the head with a [[megaphone]] by a pro-Palestinian protester in [[Thousand Oaks]], [[California]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/jewish-man-died-israel-palestinian-demonstration-california-c76a49e7c7e3dc18bc8e62633f143351 (AP)]
**Hundreds of pro-Palestinian demonstrators rally at the [[Port of Tacoma]], [[Washington state|Washington]], United States, to block the sailing of a [[military]] supply vessel that they believe will carry weapons from the United States to Israel.[https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/11/7/protesters-block-us-military-ship-allegedly-carrying-weapons-for-israel (Al Jazeera)]
*Alleged cult leader [[Jey Rence Quilario]] and three other members of the [[Socorro Bayanihan Services]] are arrested at the [[Senate of the Philippines|Philippine Senate]] after a hearing over charges of human trafficking and other human rights abuses. [https://www.rappler.com/philippines/senor-aguila-jey-rence-quilario-socorro-cult-leaders-arrested-human-rights-abuses/ (Rappler)].

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Portuguese government corruption investigation]]
**[[Prime Minister of Portugal|Portuguese Prime Minister]] [[António Costa]] resigns amid an ongoing corruption probe. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-67346780 (BBC News)]
*[[2023 United States elections]]
**[[2023 Kentucky gubernatorial election]]
***In [[Kentucky]], [[Governor of Kentucky|Governor]] [[Andy Beshear]] is re-elected, defeating [[Attorney General of Kentucky|Attorney General]] [[Daniel Cameron (American politician)|Daniel Cameron]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/11/07/us/politics/beshear-kentucky-governor-election.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[Cannabis in the United States]]
***[[Cannabis in Ohio]]
****In [[Ohio]], voters approve the [[2023 Ohio Issue 2]] to legalize recreational marijuana in [[Cannabis in Ohio|the state]]. [https://www.dispatch.com/story/news/politics/elections/2023/11/06/ohio-issue-2-live-election-results-2023-state-votes-on-recreational-marijuana/71205541007/ (''The Columbus Dispatch'')]
**[[Off-year elections]] for ballot measures, state legislatures, [[2023 United States gubernatorial elections|governors]], and other statewide offices are held in several [[U.S.]] states. [https://apnews.com/article/election-2023-kentucky-mississippi-governor-virginia-ohio-abortion-uvalde-houston-c1ebf7c4af31da60bd96a8158c86fb29 (AP)]
